# Lauri Hänninen | Product Marketing Lead (PMM)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Senior Product Marketing Leader and Technical Strategist based in Prague. Expert in GTM for hardware security (Trezor), B2B SaaS (GoodData), and open-source ecosystems. 10+ years of experience bridging engineering and market growth.

## Site Overview
- **Role:** Product Marketing Lead at Trezor; Chapter Lead for Product Marketing Alliance (PMA) Prague.
- **Expertise:** Strategic Positioning, GTM Execution, Technical Narrative Design, and Product-Led Growth.
- **Background:** M.Sc. in Economics with academic foundations in Computer Science and Psychology.
